title: The e2e check runs the project's testLevel:e2e cases as a distinct pull-request-checks CI job
asA: operator whose project applies at least one blueprint declaring a browserSurface
iWant: the materialised pull-request-checks workflow to contain a distinct e2e job that runs the project's testLevel:e2e test cases against a local preview or a --parity-env runtime, uploads browser artefacts (screenshots, HTML captures) as workflow artefacts, and reports its outcome to the aggregate pipeline report as a distinct row from the unit and integration rows
soThat: browser-facing projects get a first-class e2e job in CI while API-only projects (no applied blueprint declaring a browserSurface) keep the pull-request-checks shape verbatim. The elicited check checkSet.e2e defaults on when a browserSurface is declared on any applied blueprint, off otherwise; an operator explicit `checkSet.e2e: off` in .rcf/config/delivery-ci-workflows.json is honoured (spec 2.3).

acceptanceCriteria.description: When at least one applied blueprint declares .browserSurface.declared: true on its source blueprint.json AND checkSet.e2e is not explicitly false in .rcf/config/delivery-ci-workflows.json, the materialised pull-request-checks workflow contains a distinct e2e job that (a) runs the project's testLevel: e2e test cases against a local preview or a --parity-env runtime, (b) uploads screenshots and HTML captures as workflow artefacts, (c) reports its outcome to .rcf/reports/ci/pipeline.json as a distinct row from unit and integration rows, and (d) writes a per-gate report at .rcf/reports/ci/e2e.json with checkKind: "e2e". Projects that apply no browser-facing blueprint materialise no e2e job; projects that apply one but set checkSet.e2e: off in the config also materialise no e2e job.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a project with .rcf/config/delivery-ci-workflows.json declared and at least one blueprint applied
acceptanceCriteria.when: the workflow-materialiser runs against the project chain
acceptanceCriteria.then: an e2e job is present in the materialised pull-request-checks workflow iff (a) at least one applied blueprint's source blueprint.json carries .browserSurface.declared: true and (b) checkSet.e2e is not false; when materialised the job satisfies the four points above; a project that applies no browser-facing blueprint (or that turns the check off) materialises the pull-request-checks workflow byte-identical to a 2.1 project
